question:
In the following question, out of the given four alternatives, select the alternative which best expresses the meaning of the Idiom/Phrase.

 come into the open
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"come into the open"** means to become public or evident; **to reveal or disclose something that was previously hidden or unknown. **(सार्वजनिक या स्पष्ट होना)

 
 
• **Example: **The scandal finally** came into the open** after months of investigation.
 
 
 
• **"To become public or evident"** refers to the act of making something known to the public that was previously hidden or secret. (सार्वजनिक या स्पष्ट होना)
 
 
• **Example: **The truth about the company's financial troubles came into the open after an audit.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: ***To become public or evident.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **To leave the work** (काम छोड़ना): To stop working or abandon one's job.

 
 
• **Example:** He decided to leave the work and start his own business.
 
 
 
• **To accept the challenge** (चुनौती स्वीकार करना): To agree to face a challenge or difficult task.
 
 
• **Example: **She accepted the challenge to climb the highest mountain.
 
 
 
• **To open new business** (नया व्यवसाय शुरू करना): To start a new business or enterprise.
 
 
• **Example: **They plan to open a new business in the downtown area.
 
 

 

31:Tb68,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.
